title: Do Safe Deposit Boxes rent discounts combine? Senior, employee and the best-single rule
content:
## Scope

This policy covers the senior and employee rent discounts on Safe Deposit Boxes, and the rule that decides which single discount a rental's yearly rent charge receives when more than one is available.

## Policy clause

1. The senior discount applies when the lessee is at least 65 years old, in whole years, on the rent due date.
2. The employee discount applies to active PCB employees.
3. The senior discount and the employee discount may each apply to every rental of the customer.
4. Discounts combine under the best-single rule: only the largest discount available to a given rental is applied. Discounts never add together.
5. The discounts available to a rental are judged on its rent due date: any relationship discount the rental has earned for an active checking tier held, the senior discount and the employee discount, each with its percent.
6. The discount is fixed when the year's rent is charged. Holdings opened or closed later in that rental year do not change it. The discount applied and its percent are recorded with that year's rent charge.

## Rates by box size

| Official box size | Senior discount | Senior age | Employee discount | How discounts combine |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | 10 percent | 65 years | 50 percent | Best single only |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | 10 percent | 65 years | 50 percent | Best single only |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | 10 percent | 65 years | 50 percent | Best single only |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | 10 percent | 65 years | 50 percent | Best single only |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | 10 percent | 65 years | 50 percent | Best single only |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | 10 percent | 65 years | 50 percent | Best single only |

## Senior age: boundary cases

The dates below are hypothetical.

| Rent due date | Lessee's 65th birthday | Age on the rent due date | Senior discount available for that year |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 April | 1 April of the same year | 65 | Yes |
| 1 April | 2 April of the same year | 64 | No |
| 1 April | 31 March of the same year | 65 | Yes |

Because the discount is fixed when the year's rent is charged, a lessee who turns 65 the day after the rent due date does not gain the senior discount for that rental year.

## Choosing the single discount: hypothetical cases

- A lessee aged 70 who is an active PCB employee has the senior discount of 10 percent and the employee discount of 50 percent available on a rental. Only the larger, 50 percent, is applied.
- A rental that has earned a relationship discount of a hypothetical 25 percent, held by a lessee aged 68, has 25 percent and 10 percent available. Only 25 percent is applied.
- A lessee aged 66 with no other discount has only the senior discount available; 10 percent is applied.

## Wrong reading and correct basis

| Wrong reading | Correct basis |
|---|---|
| The senior and employee discounts together give 60 percent. | Discounts never add together; only the largest single discount, 50 percent, is applied. |
| The smaller discount is applied to what remains after the larger one. | Only one discount is applied to a rental's charge. |
| Opening a Premier Checking account mid-year lowers the current year's rent. | The discount is fixed when the year's rent is charged and is not changed by holdings opened or closed later in that rental year. |
| The senior discount is judged on the day the customer calls. | Age is judged on the rent due date. |
